title: John Glenn's 'fireflies' were ice crystals

tellings.quote: or like uh John Glenn, you know, with the the little ice crystals ice crystals.

plain: In 1962 the astronaut John Glenn orbited Earth in the capsule Friendship 7 and reported glowing "fireflies" outside, which were really little ice crystals. The researcher and skeptic Michael Shermer mentions it in passing, without naming a source, as an example of a strange sight in the sky that turned out to be ordinary.
